page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (a c.21, b c.15). Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: men neque in tuo Apostolico codice, neque in ullo alio vetustiori Nicæna Synodo monumento monstrari possit. Adhæc eadem Nicæna Synodus negat vel regulam vel consuetudinem tradidisse, ut quod in quibusdam locis fiebat, presbyteris gratiam sacræ communionis diaconi porrigerent. Ergo inquam, etiam ante Nicænam Synodum extabat regula, obtinebat consuetudo, ne diaconi id facerent. Hic rursus Turrianum convenio; Eam regulam nobis ille vel in suo Apostolico codice, vel apud aliquam Synodum Nicæna vetustiorem legat; vel si nullam invenit, illud certe confiteatur, quod nos volumus, fuisse etiam ante illa tempora, quasdam in Ecclesia regulas, ac consuetudines, quæ neque in suo codice, neque in aliis, quæ extant, Nicæna Synodo anterioribus monumentis leguntur. a c.21. Jam Ancyrani Patres a τὸν πρώτερον ὅρον, antiquam, interprete Dionysio, definitionem, sive regulam prohibuisse ajunt, ne mulieres, quæ fornicatæ fœtus in utero perimerent, ante vitæ exitum communionem acciperent. Et Neocæsariensis Synodus affirmat b c.15. b, septem esse debere diaconos in unaquaque Ecclesia κατὰ τὸν καυόνα, juxta regulam. Ostendat nobis Turrianus vel in Apostolico suo codice, vel in aliquo duobus iisdem Synodis vetustioririmo-

page.notes: Nicæna Synodus and the following text is printed partly in italic; Greek phrases transcribed as best legible. The final word of the page continues "rimo-" on the next page (catchword-like "rimo-" at the foot right). Some marginal letters are doubtful; the Greek of the note at "a" and the Greek "ἡ κατὰ τὸν κανόνα" may be misread. The printed word "duobusistis" is read as "duobusistis" (possibly "duobus illis").
